blocks.en: We shall need a notion of subsolutions to the Dirichlet problem which does not require them to be of class $C^2(\Omega)$. The definition is motivated by the maximum principle.
blocks.zh: 需要一个 Dirichlet 问题下解的概念, 不要求下解属于 $C^2(\Omega)$ 类. 这一定义由最大值原理启发而来.

blocks.en: A function $u$ in $C^0(\overline\Omega)$ is called \textbf{subharmonic} (\textbf{superharmonic}), if for every ball $B$ with $\overline B\subset\Omega$ and every function $h\in C(\overline B)$ with $h$ harmonic in $B$ and $u\leq h$ ($u\geq h$) on $\partial B$, we have $u\leq h$ ($u\geq h$) in $B$. A subsolution (supersolution) of the Dirichlet problem is a function $u\in C(\overline\Omega)$ which is subharmonic (superharmonic) and such that $u\leq g$ ($u\geq g$) on $\partial\Omega$.
blocks.zh: 若对每个满足 $\overline B\subset\Omega$ 的球 $B$, 以及每个函数 $h\in C(\overline B)$, 只要 $h$ 在 $B$ 内调和且在 $\partial B$ 上满足 $u\leq h$ ($u\geq h$), 就有在 $B$ 内 $u\leq h$ ($u\geq h$), 则称 $C^0(\overline\Omega)$ 中的函数 $u$ 为\textbf{次调和的} (\textbf{超调和的}). Dirichlet 问题的下解 (上解) 是次调和 (超调和) 函数 $u\in C(\overline\Omega)$, 且在 $\partial\Omega$ 上 $u\leq g$ ($u\geq g$).
blocks.label: def:continuous-subharmonic-function
